headline: BAL @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.04 at TBR 5.38, with a projected total of 9.42. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: BAL moved +0.18 runs while TBR moved +0.39, changing the projected margin by -0.21 runs. The projected total climbed +0.57, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -12.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Cedric Mullins, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production.
